title: jména souborů v dávce pro ČSOB
interface: final class Drupal\csobrec\Service\Naming, no constructor arguments, no service needed. Methods: mp3(\DateTimeImmutable $time, string $activity): string returns 'DA_<YmdHis>_<activity>.mp3'; batch(\DateTimeImmutable $time): string returns 'DA_<Y><n><j><His>' — year four digits, month and day WITHOUT a leading zero, time always six digits; xml(\DateTimeImmutable $time): string is batch() plus '.xml'; don(\DateTimeImmutable $time): string is batch() plus '.don'. The formats are copied from samples ČSOB accepts; the asymmetry between mp3() and batch() is deliberate and must stay. Use the DateTimeImmutable's own timezone — never convert to UTC or to the site timezone, or a late-evening call would be renamed to the day before.
